<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
print("total nodes:", len(nodes))
# Group by color, print bbox + size for each
from collections import defaultdict
byc = defaultdict(list)
for n in nodes:
    r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']); r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
    c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']); c1=max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
    byc[n['color']].append((n['id'],n['pixels'],(r0,r1,c0,c1),n['hash'][:6]))
for c in sorted(byc):
    print(c, len(byc[c]))
    for x in byc[c][:20]:
        print("  ",x)
